title: Pepsi: From back-counter soda fountain to one of America’s most iconic brands
summary: The Pepsi story is one of innovation, reinvention and lasting cultural impact. What began as a local favorite known as “Brad’s Drink,” evolved into one of the most iconic consumer brands shaped by more than a century of memorable moments across food, sports, music and entertainment.
body_markdown:
The decades that followed continued to bring growth in the U.S. and around the world. In 1951, Pepsi introduced its distinctive red, white and blue bottle cap that would evolve into the iconic “globe” logo the brand is still known for today. Then in 1965, when the Pepsi-Cola Company merged with Frito-Lay — the makers of namesake Fritos, Lay’s and other famous snacks — PepsiCo was formed.


The creation of PepsiCo marked a new era for the company, and it would continue to evolve Pepsi branding and offerings throughout the 20th century and beyond.


That spirit of reinvention would help shape a pivotal moment for the brand: The Pepsi Challenge. Launched more than 50 years ago, the blind taste test invited consumers to choose between Pepsi and its competitor, turning the confidence Pepsi had in its bold taste into a cultural phenomenon and creating a lasting and enduring proof point for the brand’s superior taste.


Today, Pepsi is bringing that same challenger mindset to a new generation with Pepsi Zero Sugar. To mark the Challenge’s 50th anniversary, Pepsi relaunched the iconic taste test for a new era, putting Pepsi Zero Sugar head-to-head with its competitor as consumer demand for zero-sugar cola continues to grow. In 2025, Pepsi Zero Sugar won in 100% of national tour markets where the challenge was conducted.


The Pepsi Challenge is just one chapter in a history defined by the brand’s ability to show up at the center of culture. Across food, sports, music and entertainment, Pepsi has been part of some of culture’s most memorable moments — with its great taste becoming a cornerstone of family gatherings, backyard barbecues, gamedays, tailgates and celebrations of all kinds.
